title: Yellow Kenyan Pumpkin Seeds Tagine
description: A traditional Kenyan dish featuring roasted pumpkin seeds, served in a terracotta dish with a blend of earthy spices, perfect for a post-workout snack. This flexitarian-friendly recipe incorporates shio-cure for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spread the pumpkin seeds on a baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes.
Remove the seeds from the oven and let them cool.
Grind the roasted seeds into a coarse powder using a spice grinder or mortar and pestle.
Heat the olive oil in a large terracotta dish over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the dish and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the dish and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shio-cure and pumpkin seed powder to the dish and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the tagine for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
